title: Unified capability provider declaration
description: One shape every capability provider satisfies, whether it is bundled with the skill, installed as an extension, or supplied by a third-party skill that ships sdlc-capability.json beside its SKILL.md. Bundled and extension providers satisfy this contract by projection; a third-party provider authors it directly.

id.description: Provider identity, meaning the implementation that serves the capability. A third-party provider may not claim 'sdlc', an 'sdlc-' prefixed name, or the name of a core capability. Each bundled implementation declares 'sdlc-' followed by the capability it serves.

capability.description: The capability served, named exactly as the module registry names it.

mode.description: Relationship to the bundled default. 'default' is the bundle's own projection, 'augment' adds a capability without displacing a guarantee, and 'replace' asks to be trusted where a qualified module is trusted today.

instructions.description: Relative path to the instruction document, confined to the provider directory. For a third-party provider this is its own Agent Skill document, whose frontmatter name and sdlc metadata must match this declaration.

evidence.description: The evidence clauses that satisfy the capability. A replacing provider never restates its own obligations; the registry retains them.

evaluations.description: Relative path to evaluation cases. Required when mode is 'replace', because displacing a qualified module requires demonstrating parity.

compatibleSdlc.description: Supported SDLC version range, such as '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0'.
